added_claim_errors: "같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%의 지연이자" (repeated in the HR text as "근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제17조에 따른 지연이자"): wrong legal basis. The key puts severance delay interest under 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, not 퇴직급여법 제17조. Putting a wrong article in a message to HR weakens it.

"퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원": overstated. My own recomputation with 4 years of service (근속연수공제 400만, 환산급여공제) gives about 9.4만 to 14.1만 won including local tax, matching the key. Also, after an IRP transfer nothing is withheld at payment.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 퇴직급여법 제43조 sets 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction).
"고용노동부와 법제처도 퇴직금 산정에 이 조항이 적용된다고 해석합니다": no link or document number. The 법제처 part matches the key; the 고용노동부 interpretation is unverified.
"퇴직금은 원칙적으로 IRP 계정으로 이전": leaves out the under-55 condition (minor).
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 퇴직급여법 제43조 sets 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction).
"현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전하는 방식": leaves out the under-55 condition (minor).

reasons: Both answers correct the company at the start: the deadline is 14 days, and an extension needs a mutual agreement. Both also give the 1,024만 to 1,202만 range from the ordinary-wage floor. B's figures are exact (1,158 days, 12,022,000 and 10,242,000 won, a 178만 gap, 21 days overdue, about 6,600 won a day in interest). A rounds the service period to 3.17 years and gets 1,023만 and 1,200만. B's HR text is closer to the key: it asks for the breakdown, asks how to send IRP details, and stays non-threatening. A's text cites the wrong article (퇴직급여법 제17조) for delay interest and leaves out IRP. A also adds a wrong tax estimate (20만 to 25만). Both repeat the old penalty amounts, and neither gives a full checklist of facts to confirm.
